jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description: Overview Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering. Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit. The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era. We have one product: new physics, at scale. Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact. Â Role and Responsibilities Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting. The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on. Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first. We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit. What We're Looking For A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials. Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list. You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently. A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically. Nice to Have Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security. Experience in research or scientific computing environments. Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem. Â How We Work We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage. Â Location and Compensation This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery. jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description: You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply. A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. As part of A·Team, you can expect: High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate. How to apply: Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. What you’ll do: Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. Who A · Team is for: Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy. Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders. The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing Who A · Team is not for: People looking for small gigs Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet) Our long-term vision: A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. jobs.title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
jobs.description: Your tasks Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship. Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved. Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended. Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next. Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging. From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly. Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs. Your profile Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half. Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people. Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be. Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic. Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models. Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters. Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement. Why us? Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers. Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket. Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known. Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about. How to Apply Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production : what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed. Process : Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer. We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway. jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager UK
jobs.description: Our project for you: moebel.de is Europe's leading price comparison site for furniture and home furnishings. Our family of portals operates in nine European countries, including Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Italy and Poland. Now we are getting started in earnest in the UK: living24.uk is live – our price comparison site for furniture, home furnishings, garden and décor, as well as white goods and home electronics. The launch is done, the technology works. What decides the pace now are the retailers: the more relevant shops list their ranges on living24.uk, the stronger the comparison for users – and the faster the portal grows. This is not selling from a tidy list of existing accounts. You take on a freshly launched market and build the partner portfolio that living24.uk runs on. Whoever delivers over the next few months will shape what moebel.de looks like in the UK. That is why we are looking for you as Senior Sales Manager UK. Your future Tasks Building the market: you build living24.uk's partner portfolio – from first contact through pitch and negotiation to the signed contract. Your targets are UK online retailers in furniture, home furnishings, garden, décor, white goods, home electronics and small appliances. Selling a performance model: you show retailers how living24.uk pays off as an additional channel – through cost per click, visibility, feed quality and cost-of-sale. Seeing partners through to go-live: product feed, tracking, range checks – together with the team in Hamburg. After go-live our Relationship Management team takes over day-to-day care, so you can focus on winning new partners. Presence in the market: retailer visits, trade fairs and industry events across the UK. In a young market, trust is built face to face. Ear to the ground: competition, price levels, what UK retailers expect, seasonality – what you learn in the field feeds into product, pricing and priorities. Your Strenghts Several years of sales experience in UK e-commerce, ideally with a price comparison site, marketplace, affiliate network or performance marketing provider A solid network of UK retailers in our categories that you can put to work from day one Command of the performance model: CPC, CPO, affiliate, product feeds, ROAS and cost-of-sale are selling points for you, not buzzwords A hunter's mindset: you keep your own pipeline full, cold outreach included, and get deals over the line An appetite for building: pace and open questions appeal to you more than a field that has already been ploughed Working from the numbers, with clean CRM records as the basis for how you steer Willingness to travel across the UK and to regular meetings in Hamburg Fluent English at negotiation level – German is a plus, not a requirement Our Benefits Your day is yours to shape Work when you are most productive. Early bird or night owl: you set your hours flexibly, in agreement with your team. Working from another European country for a while? No problem. Your laptop is your workplace. Our culture is one of a kind Here everyone sits on the same couch, regardless of title or role. We live team spirit online and in person – gaming nights, workouts, film evenings and team events. Four times a year we meet for Company Week Working together in the office, pushing projects forward, pizza evenings and a party to finish. In the heart of Hamburg When you are in Hamburg, our office is waiting for you – centrally located between the main station, Mönckebergstraße and the Binnenalster lake. Perfect for lunch dates, a break by the Alster or a stroll after work. We are looking forward to receiving your application! Please send your application exclusively through our online application form – it goes straight to our recruiting team. You are welcome to submit your CV in English or German, ideally with your salary expectations and earliest possible start date. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Acquisitions are our second growth path. We buy established industrial distribution businesses in the EUR 20-40M revenue range, owners and management stay on board, and we connect them to our platform, our procurement, our financing lines and our AI stack. Three deals are live, two are close to signature, and at run rate we intend to close around five per year out of a mapped universe of roughly 200 targets. Role Overview You own what happens after signing. Origination, valuation and deal execution sit with the CEO and our senior M&A advisor. Your mandate starts the day a company becomes part of Andercore and it ends when that company runs better than it did before. These are analog businesses. Fifteen years old, owner-led, hemdsärmelig, a well-run P&L and almost no technology underneath it. They are profitable, they are growing, and they are at their operational limit. Our hypothesis is that our platform, our purchasing power, our credit facilities and our automation take them past that limit. Your job is to find out on the ground whether that hypothesis holds, in which order, and at what pace - and then to make it happen with the management team, not to them. We do not arrive as the saviour with the AI magic box. We say so explicitly to every seller, and you will hold that line. What You Will Own Holding Management from Day 1 Access to accounting and financials from day one, monthly numbers on a fixed close, one reporting framework across all acquired entities. Set the baseline: revenue, margin, working capital, cash, customer and supplier concentration. No opinion without the number behind it. Pick up the commitments made during due diligence and turn them into the operating rhythm of the first 100 days. Run the portfolio as a financial participation first. Both companies are growing. Do not put anything into a skid. On-the-Ground Diagnosis Spend real time inside the acquired businesses and find out where they actually stand, which is never where they say they stand. We're looking for a Contractor Development Manager to lead that effort. This is a business development role. You'll identify the contractors who fit our ideal contractor profile and make sure they register to the platform, get them verified and onboard them to the platform. We are looking for experience in business development rather than experience in our sector, and you'll have full support getting to know Plentific and the contractor market. What you'll do Grow our contractor network Find and reach out to contractors who match our ideal contractor profile. Our platform combines marketplace infrastructure, workflow software, automation, and operational analytics. It is designed for the complexity, volume, and regulatory demands of social housing, public sector property portfolios, and large residential operations. We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. The PMO Lead owns this function day to day — coaching Programme and Project Managers (PMs) to a consistently high standard, building the portfolio-level reporting that gives leadership real visibility, and acting as the bridge between delivery teams and senior management when a decision or an unblock is needed. This is a hands-on, first-of-its-kind role at Plentific: the PMO Lead will stand up the standards, cadence, and reporting described below largely from scratch, and will be judged on how quickly the portfolio becomes visible, consistent, and genuinely governed as a result. Set and enforce mandatory reporting — PMs submit standard, current status on a fixed cadence; the PMO follows up where reporting lapses. 2. Prepare and present the portfolio report at each Steering Committee review. Track benefits realisation — confirm delivered programmes actually produced the outcome they were funded for. 3. Work with senior management to report and unblock Act as the primary escalation point when a programme risk or dependency needs a decision above the PM’s authority. Bring blockers to the right senior stakeholder quickly, with a clear ask and options — not just a status update. Represent delivery status and risk to senior management accurately and without spin, including when the news is difficult. Chair or co-chair the portfolio review, and prepare materials for Steering Committee meetings. Track follow-through on decisions and unblocks agreed with senior management, so they don’t silently drop. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — AI-Native Engineering (XTM Foundation)
jobs.description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran. We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey. You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead. 💼 Your Responsibilities Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast. Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce. Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond. Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures. Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours. Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone. Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team. Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO. Working model: You

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Executive
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01) et Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour par semaine sur chaque site et 3 jours de télétravail. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER (H/F)
jobs.description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS   Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.   Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).   Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).     VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact. VOS MISSIONS Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion. Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison. Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication. VOTRE PROFIL  Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques. Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs. Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere. Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint. Très bonne maîtrise du motion design. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes. Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris.  Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Technicien(ne) en robotique - Maintenance & SAV
jobs.description: Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos sociétés nous ouvrons un poste de Technicien(ne). Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage. Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV. Votre mission Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage. Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots : Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages Software : configuration, mises à jour, firmware, navigation, analyse des erreurs et diagnostics Circuits d’eau : pompes, tuyaux, vannes, filtres, réservoirs et recherche de fuites Aspiration & nettoyage : moteurs d’aspiration, turbines, filtres, brosses et systèmes de lavage Mécanique : roues, transmissions, moteurs, démontage, réparation et remplacement de composants Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux. Requirements Nous recherchons une personne technique, polyvalente, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement d’une machine et rechercher l’origine d’une panne. Formations recherchées : Automaticien(ne) CFC Mécatronicien(ne) Électronicien(ne) CFC Polymécanicien(ne) CFC Technicien(ne) ES en systèmes industriels / automation ou formation technique équivalente Une expérience dans la robotique est un avantage, mais n’est pas obligatoire. Une expérience en maintenance de machines, équipements industriels ou électromécaniques est également très intéressante. Compétences: Bonnes connaissances en électronique, électricité et mécanique Très bonne aisance informatique Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques Autonomie, rigueur et sens pratique Intérêt pour la robotique et les nouvelles technologies Français courant et bonnes connaissances d’anglais technique Allemand : un avantage Permis de conduire catégorie B Benefits Vous rejoignez un projet en forte croissance et participez au développement d’un centre d’expertise en robotique professionnelle en Suisse, avec des formations auprès de fabricants internationaux et la possibilité de travailler sur de nouvelles générations de robots. jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Work in sprints with other engineers (backend, frontend, SRE, and other CPEs) as part of a cross-functional team to deliver new features into production.  Collaborate with other squads in Product Development and Mission Control to ensure solutions fit into the Sonar platform. Contribute to your squad’s efforts in operating its services through, i.e., definition and upkeeping SLOs, investigate alarms and respond to incidents to maintain a high quality of service. Experience and qualifications Must Have:  2+ years of experience with architecting, developing, and operating cloud solutions on AWS for Web/API applications. Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C# or similar. Experience with at least one scripting language such as Bash or similar. jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Risk Manager
jobs.description: Who we are: Swissblock is a private investment firm dedicated to cross-asset investing. We employ a systematic framework that integrates robust algorithmic trading with exhaustive market analysis. We manage a diverse range of multi-strategy portfolios across all major asset classes through dedicated teams, including purely systematic groups. The Role: We’re building the risk infrastructure for our traditional-financing trading groups from the ground up, and we’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Risk Manager to help shape it. You’ll report to the Head of Risk, work closely with portfolio managers and engineers. Location Switzerland (role can be based anywhere in Switzerland). Our office is based in Baar, Zug. Hyrbid with the option to work from home up to four days a week. What you’ll be doing: Build the risk engine: VaR/CVaR, stress testing, and scenario analysis across all strategies Co-design the limit framework with the Head of Risk Independently validate systematic strategies Own daily monitoring and escalation of market, liquidity, and counterparty risk, and produce the daily and monthly risk reports Develop AI-assisted risk workflows with clear guardrails and human sign-off Bring the risk perspective to new products, strategies and firm-wide projects What you’ll bring: 5+ years in quantitative or investment risk at a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, or multi-strategy platform; Bank market-risk experience covering trading books is also welcome A degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, engineering, economics or finance. An MSc or PhD preferred, and FRM, CFA, CQF is a plus Deep hands-on knowledge of VaR, CVaR, stress and scenario analysis, backtesting, including their limitations A solid grasp of equities, fixed income, FX, commodities/energy, and credit, including their derivatives Production-quality Python and solid SQL, and experience working in shared codebase with version control and CI/CD Experience designing and implementing risk management frameworks Initiative, the ability to work independently and the drive to automate processes where it adds value and reliability A collaborative approach in a small, hands-on team Fluent in English (written and spoken), German is an advantage Why Swissblock? At Swissblock, we provide a dynamic and diverse environment with flat hierarchies and excellent colleagues. As a profitable company, our culture is built on responsibility and performance, with empowerment as a core value. This is reflected in career opportunities that grow alongside the company. What we offer Ownership & impact: A collaborative, high-ownership environment and excellent colleagues Growth & development: Empowerment and career development that grows with the business Remote-friendly culture: Modern office in Baar, Switzerland, with the flexibility to work remotely Compensation: Competitive compensation, including a performance-based annual bonus Time off: 25 days of paid leave Community: Regular company events Benefits: Progressive social benefits Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team. In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit. We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations. This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility. Location & work mode Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required. What you'll do Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other What we're looking for 5+ years experience in Product Management in B2B SaaS Background in Software Engineering A track record of shipping things people actually use Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience Exceptional product and operational judgement Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus Shameless customer obsession Extreme clarity in writing

jobs.title: Manager Einkauf (w/m/d) Datacenter Infrastructure
jobs.description: Über IONOS Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns. Aufgaben Einkauf von Gütern und Dienstleistungen im Datacenter-Umfeld für die Märkte USA, UK und Spanien Durchführung und Verhandlung von Lieferanten- und Rahmenverträgen gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen technischen Fachabteilungen. Markt- und Lieferantenanalyse in den genannten Ländern zur Identifikation geeigneter Lieferanten und Optimierungspotenziale. Enge Zusammenarbeit und Unterstützung der technischen Fachbereiche bei Bedarf, auch über die genannten Länder hinaus. Steuerung von RFP-Prozessen sowie der Lieferantenqualifizierung und -zertifizierung. Abwicklung der Beschaffungsprozesse über unsere P2P-Systemlandschaft (Coupa). Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Einkaufsrichtlinien und Compliance-Vorgaben. Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Einkaufsprozesse im internationalen Kontext. Qualifikationen Abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen o. Ä.) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Einkauf, idealerweise im Datacenter- oder IT-Infrastrukturumfeld. Fundiertes technisches und kaufmännisches Fachwissen. Kenntnisse in der Beschaffung Datacenter-spezifischer Güter (z. B. Elektro-/Kühltechnik, Long-Lead- Equipment) von Vorteil. Marktkenntnisse in den USA, UK und Spanien. Ausgeprägtes analytisches und finanzielles Verständnis. Erfahrung in der Führung von Vertragsverhandlungen. Praxiserfahrung mit P2P-Systemen, idealerweise Coupa. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Spanischkenntnisse von Vorteil. Zielstrebige, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke sowie Teamfähigkeit. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell. Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: TL;DR Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology. We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked. We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them. The problem we're solving Large organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting. GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow. Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems. What we're looking for You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here. You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions. You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached. You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them. You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere. You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence. You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents. You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to. What you'll do Over your first year: Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. What you'll do Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work. Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist. Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE ) About the role... Travellers drag their bags around London all day because they don't know there's another option. Bounce is looking for four Scouts/ Brand Ambassadors, two at King's Cross and two at Victoria, to tell them that option exists. Bounce is the world's largest luggage storage network, with hundreds of locations in London and over 1.1 million bags stored in the city alone. Travellers book on their phone, drop their bags at a local shop or hotel, and get on with their day. This is a self-employed, commission-only role. You earn 40% of the storage value of every booking that comes through your code, and you keep it whether or not the customer uses the discount. For example: What an hour could look like (illustrative, not guaranteed): You speak to around 30 travellers 5 of them book (about 1 in 6) The average booking is three bags for the day, which earns you £5.40 5 bookings × £5.40 = £27 for the hour Where you come in… Positioned around King's Cross or Victoria station and talk to travellers who are dragging suitcases around London Wear Bounce branded gear with your own QR code on it: travellers scan it, book a spot and get 10% off Find people with bags, help them get rid of them for the day, and get paid for it Decide when you go out and for how long, with no fixed schedule or minimum commitment Get set up with your own referral code, QR code, payout account and Bounce branded kit Start with a briefing on what to say, which spots work, and what to steer clear of Get commission paid out through our affiliate system, straight to your bank Your profile… You're happy starting conversations with strangers all day You're warm and quick on your feet, and travellers trust you inside five seconds Confident English. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions. About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals. No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered. We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné). Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy. Suitable candidates should have: Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship. Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code. A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility. Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset. jobs.title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée&nbsp; en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit&nbsp; de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible

jobs.title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
jobs.description: A propos du poste : Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences. Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique , nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité. Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie , vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements , tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance. Missions Principales : Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ; Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ; Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ; Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ; Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ; Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ; Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ; Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ; Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ; Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc Requirements À propos de vous Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé. Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées. Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée. Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus. Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée. Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent. Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission. Permis B requis. Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tou

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Clinical Project Manager to oversee and coordinate clinical activities in pharmaceutical environment. The role involves managing operational aspects of clinical trials, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and acting as the primary interface between local stakeholders, investigators, vendors, and global teams. This position requires strong autonomy, rigor, and excellent communication skills , with the ability to navigate cross‑functional environments. Key Responsibilities : 1. Study Management Lead and coordinate clinical trial activities at the local level from start‑up to close‑out. Ensure local execution of global study plans in alignment with timelines and quality standards. Serve as the key point of contact for local investigational sites and regional stakeholders. 2. Regulatory & Compliance Oversight Ensure that clinical trial activities comply with local regulations, ICH‑GCP, and internal SOPs. Coordinate local submissions to competent authorities and ethics committees when required. Monitor adherence to regulatory timelines and manage any corrective actions. 3. Site & Vendor Coordination Support site selection, activation, monitoring, and close‑out in collaboration with CRAs and vendors. Manage relationships with local vendors (logistics, labs, CRO partners). Follow up on recruitment progress, performance, and site‑level metrics. 4. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Work closely with global study teams, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, and clinical operations. Participate in study meetings and provide updates on local activities, challenges, and achievements. Support risk mitigation plans and operational troubleshooting. 5. Data Quality & Operational Tracking Oversee data accuracy, query resolution, and compliance of documentation. Track KPIs, patient recruitment, timelines, and operational deliverables. Contribute to audit and inspection readiness. Requirements Experienced in Clinical Operations within pharma or CRO. Experience as Clinical Project Manager, Study Manager, or equivalent . Previous involvement in interventional trials (Phase II–IV preferred). Solid understanding of ICH‑GCP, regulatory environment, and local clinical research practices. Experience collaborating with investigators, CROs, and cross‑functional teammates. Strong organizational, operational, and communication skills. Ability to manage several tasks simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment. Fluency in French and English (written & spoken). Benefits Why join us? At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare. Here's what makes us unique: We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience. Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey. Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
